title: Apple Inc. (AAPL) is Sentry Investment Management LLC’s Largest Position
text:
Sentry Investment Management LLC lowered its stake in Apple Inc. (NASDAQ:AAPL) by 9.7% during the first quarter, according to the company in its most recent filing with the SEC. The institutional investor owned 400,319 shares of the iPhone maker’s stock after selling 42,985 shares during the quarter. Apple makes up about 4.1% of Sentry Investment Management LLC’s holdings, making the stock its biggest position. Sentry Investment Management LLC’s holdings in Apple were worth $67,166,000 as of its most recent filing with the SEC.

Miracle Mile Advisors LLC now owns 98,783 shares of the iPhone maker’s stock valued at $16,574,000 after acquiring an additional 43,058 shares during the last quarter. Morse Asset Management Inc increased its holdings in shares of Apple by 3.7% during the 1st quarter. Morse Asset Management Inc now owns 29,378 shares of the iPhone maker’s stock worth $4,929,000 after buying an additional 1,035 shares during the last quarter. D.B. Turim 21 Investimentos Ltda. increased its holdings in shares of Apple by 5.1% during the 1st quarter. Turim 21 Investimentos Ltda. now owns 59,421 shares of the iPhone maker’s stock worth $9,970,000 after buying an additional 2,906 shares during the last quarter. Daiwa Securities Group Inc. now owns 380,790 shares of the iPhone maker’s stock worth $63,889,000 after buying an additional 88,632 shares during the last quarter. 58.04% of the stock is currently owned by hedge funds and other institutional investors. In related news, SVP Daniel J. Riccio sold 17,375 shares of the firm’s stock in a transaction that occurred on Wednesday, April 4th. The shares were sold at an average price of $169.12, for a total value of $2,938,460.00. Following the completion of the transaction, the senior vice president now owns 66,191 shares of the company’s stock, valued at approximately $11,194,221.92. The transaction was disclosed in a document filed with the Securities & Exchange Commission, which is available at the SEC website . Also, insider Philip W. Schiller sold 69,491 shares of the firm’s stock in a transaction that occurred on Tuesday, April 3rd. The stock was sold at an average price of $166.42, for a total transaction of $11,564,692.22. The disclosure for this sale can be found here . Insiders have sold 279,074 shares of company stock valued at $49,607,454 over the last 90 days. 0.08% of the stock is currently owned by insiders.
NASDAQ AAPL opened at $184.92 on Monday. Apple Inc. has a 12 month low of $142.28 and a 12 month high of $194.20. The company has a current ratio of 1.46, a quick ratio of 1.37 and a debt-to-equity ratio of 0.80. The company has a market cap of $938.29 billion, a P/E ratio of 20.08, a P/E/G ratio of 1.52 and a beta of 1.29.
Apple (NASDAQ:AAPL) last issued its earnings results on Tuesday, May 1st. The iPhone maker reported $2.73 earnings per share for the quarter, topping the Zacks’ consensus estimate of $2.69 by $0.04. The firm had revenue of $61.14 billion during the quarter, compared to analysts’ expectations of $60.94 billion. Apple had a net margin of 21.55% and a return on equity of 39.97%. The firm’s revenue for the quarter was up 15.6% compared to the same quarter last year. During the same period last year, the firm posted $2.10 earnings per share. sell-side analysts predict that Apple Inc. will post 11.42 EPS for the current fiscal year.
Apple declared that its board has approved a share repurchase program on Tuesday, May 1st that permits the company to repurchase $100.00 billion in shares. This repurchase authorization permits the iPhone maker to reacquire up to 11.9% of its shares through open market purchases. Shares repurchase programs are generally a sign that the company’s board believes its stock is undervalued.
A number of analysts have recently commented on AAPL shares. Bank of America restated a “buy” rating and set a $220.00 price objective on shares of Apple in a report on Friday, March 23rd. Vetr upgraded Apple from a “hold” rating to a “buy” rating and set a $184.49 price objective for the company in a report on Monday, March 5th. ValuEngine upgraded Apple from a “hold” rating to a “buy” rating in a report on Thursday, March 1st. Rosenblatt Securities restated a “buy” rating and set a $180.00 price objective on shares of Apple in a report on Friday, March 16th. Finally, Royal Bank of Canada restated a “buy” rating and set a $205.00 price objective on shares of Apple in a report on Friday, March 9th. One analyst has rated the stock with a sell rating, sixteen have given a hold rating, thirty-one have given a buy rating and two have issued a strong buy rating to the stock. The company presently has a consensus rating of “Buy” and a consensus price target of $206.89.
Apple Company Profile
Apple Inc designs, manufactures, and markets mobile communication and media devices, and personal computers to consumers, and small and mid-sized businesses; and education, enterprise, and government customers worldwide. The company also sells related software, services, accessories, networking solutions, and third-party digital content and applications.
